pr_title: ttl: add integration test with random fault session for TTL
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #58411

### What changed and how does it work?

1. Add two tests related to TTL. One of them is the test with randomly faulty session, which cannot execute the SQL.
2. Fix the bug that the result of `getSession` is unexpected in some situation.
3. Fix the bug that the `last_job_finish_time` is not in correct TZ when the job is cancelled.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [x] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

issue_context.title: add fuzzy test for concurrent running TTL job manager
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The E2E test for TTL runs really slow. By modifying some internal variables (through failpoint), we can make it much faster. Meanwhile, we can also simulate the fault situation for TTL job managers.

Let me add such kind of tests 😃 .

review_comments: When `s.fault.Load() != nil`, the `*s.fault` can still be a nil interface.
